sources.redactions: SecretAccessKey, SessionToken, AccessKeyId/accessKeyId and confirmation tokens redacted recursively, including serialized native event strings. Credentials are only held in process memory and publisher child environment.

limits: No archive or replay is used. Elapsed time and absence of receipts do not prove a cold decrypt or terminal failure.
Receiver records HTTP response intent immediately before returning, not an SNS service acknowledgement. No direct unsigned endpoint controls are used.

EventName=Decrypt lookups retain exact owned key ARN plus topic context when present; AccessDenied with null requestParameters is retained using exact key ARN, original disposable publisher ARN, and SNS invocation identity. No message ID or topic context is fabricated into such native events.
The one-message retained-delivery experiment does not identify a fleet-wide cache TTL, topology, worker selection, or exact KMS-error retry schedule.
SNS HTTP retry jitter is measured by actual receipts; the requested policy is not an exact attempt schedule.
Topic-level delivered metrics include subscription confirmation and cannot alone prove successful delivery of the original notification.
